stops.name: Bergamasque Alps Regional Park
stops.detail: The Bergamasque Alps Regional Park (Italian: Parco regionale delle Orobie Bergamasche) is a nature reserve in Lombardy, Italy. Established in 1989, it encompasses the Bergamasque Alps, known in Italy as Alpi Orobie; with an area of nearly 70,000 hectares, it is the largest natural park in Lombardy.
